newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield falls on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yield falls on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell at Friday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 1.33 and 5.20 percent, respectively, down from 1.37 percent and 5.61 percent at Thursday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 25.599 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions and the ministry approved all the bids.
The issues were offered with par values of 20 billion levs and 45 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 20,000 million levs 45,000 million levs
Bids received 14,329 million levs 11,269.7 million levs
Bids approved 14,329 million levs 11,269.7 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 1.33 pct 5.20 pct
